tasks.prompt: Explore this repository's source code (read-only exploration, no code changes), then create a file named exploration-answer.md in the repository root with exactly three lines, one per line, in the format 'table: <answer>', 'file: <answer>', 'column: <answer>'. Line 1 answers: the name of the SQLite table that stores per-session effort-policy state. Line 2 answers: the repository-relative path of the TypeScript source file that declares that table's columns with drizzle (the hand-written declaration, not a generated file). Line 3 answers: the name of the column that stores the adaptive controller level. Finish as soon as the file is written.

Explore this repository's TUI source code (read-only exploration, no code changes), then create a file named exploration-answer.md in the repository root with exactly three lines, one per line, in the format 'id: <answer>', 'slash: <answer>', 'operation: <answer>'. Line 1 answers: the internal command id of the TUI command that opens the model variant dialog (formatted like word.word). Line 2 answers: the slash-command name, without the leading slash, that triggers that command. Line 3 answers: the delegation operation name that the effort delegation defaults map the agent id 'build' to. Finish as soon as the file is written.
